name: Rabshakeh
bio:
Rabshakeh (an Assyrian court title, used in Scripture as a name) was the chief spokesman among the three officers Sennacherib, king of Assyria, sent from Lachish against Jerusalem. Standing before the city, he mocked Hezekiah's trust in Egypt and in the LORD, demanded Hezekiah's officials Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah pass on a message of surrender, and shouted directly to the people on the wall in Hebrew that no god of any nation had ever delivered its people from Assyria's hand, urging them to defy Hezekiah and surrender (2 Kings 18:19-35).

## 📖 Core Story: Returning to Sennacherib

Rabshakeh returned to Sennacherib, finding him now at war against Libnah after withdrawing from Lachish. Shortly after, word came that Tirhakah, king of Ethiopia, was marching to oppose Assyria, prompting Sennacherib to send a second threatening message to Hezekiah (2 Kings 19:8-9).
